name: Tamsulosin US pivotal studies
question: Does once-daily tamsulosin improve symptoms and peak urinary flow compared with placebo in men with symptomatic BPH?

design.population: 756 men with symptomatic benign prostatic hyperplasia were randomized in the primary US study.
design.description: Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 randomized trial

verdictNote: Both doses improved symptom score and peak flow; adverse events were higher at 0.8 mg.
takeaway: In the primary US phase 3 trial, tamsulosin 0.4 mg daily or 0.4 mg for 1 week then 0.8 mg daily improved AUA symptom score and peak urinary flow versus placebo over 13 weeks; the higher-dose arm had more adverse events.
